description: Debezium row of inventory.customers (unwrapped, add.fields=op,source.ts_ms,ts_ms) -> customer document, same as flink-cdc-es CustomerDocuments

script.description: full_name, registered (MicroTimestamp -> ISO-8601), CDC timestamps (ms -> ISO-8601)
script.source: List parts = new ArrayList(); if (ctx.first_name != null) { parts.add(ctx.first_name); } if (ctx.last_name != null) { parts.add(ctx.last_name); } ctx.full_name = parts.isEmpty() ? null : String.join(' ', parts); if (ctx.registered instanceof Number) { ctx.registered = Instant.EPOCH.plus(((Number) ctx.registered).longValue(), ChronoUnit.MICROS).toString(); } if (ctx.__source_ts_ms instanceof Number) { ctx.cdc_source_ts = Instant.ofEpochMilli(((Number) ctx.__source_ts_ms).longValue()).toString(); } if (ctx.__ts_ms instanceof Number) { ctx.cdc_processed_ts = Instant.ofEpochMilli(((Number) ctx.__ts_ms).longValue()).toString(); }
